macro.title: Global Oil Supply
macro.body: The ongoing tensions in the Middle East, particularly between the US and Iran, have led to a significant disruption in global oil supply. This could lead to higher oil prices, affecting the portfolio's energy holdings. The recent attack on Saudi Red Sea oil exports has further exacerbated the situation.

risks.context: 49% of the portfolio is invested in leveraged ETFs, totaling ~$135,000 CAD
risks.body: The portfolio's high leverage amplifies both gains and losses, making it more susceptible to market volatility. A significant market downturn could lead to substantial losses.

risks.context: The portfolio has a significant USD exposure, with ~$180,000 CAD invested in USD-denominated assets
risks.body: Changes in the USD/CAD exchange rate could impact the portfolio's value, particularly if the Canadian dollar strengthens against the US dollar.

risks.context: The portfolio is heavily concentrated in the technology sector, with ~20% of the portfolio invested in tech stocks
risks.body: A downturn in the technology sector could lead to significant losses, as the portfolio is heavily exposed to this sector.
